profile.headline: Senior/Lead/Principle Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Software Engineer with 10+ years designing, building, and scaling secure, high-availability backend systems, APIs, and micro services. 

Hands-on across Node.js / TypeScript and .NET Core / .NET 8 / C#, with deep database expertise in MySQL and MS SQL Server. Recently built cloud-native security scanning micro services. 

Practices a plan-first, AI-assisted development workflow with Claude and ChatGPT agents, backed by rigorous PR review. Security-first mindset shaped by years of SSL/PKI, OAuth/JWT, and payment processing work in a compliance-driven environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Formerly The SSL Store / Rapid Web Services, acquired by DigiCert in August 2020; continued with expanded scope.

positions.title: Development Project Leader
positions.description: The project provides a facility to purchase an online SSL certificate for the domain or organization. The system uses the API to generate the SSL certificate for the Client or reseller and send the certificate to the authorized person. It has REST API to provide the facility to place an order through it. API is also integrated with hosting and billing systems like WHMCS, CPanel etc. Tuncer Info Tech is the world's 3 largest Reseller which provides SSL Certificates. It also supports payment gateways like Authorize.NET and PayPal.
